job.title: Registered Nurse – Telemetry (Nights)
description: Summit Ridge Hospital is a 280-bed community hospital and a designated Level III trauma center. This year we are transitioning our clinical documentation from Cerner to Epic.

The Telemetry RN provides direct care to adult cardiac and medical patients on continuous cardiac monitoring in our 36-bed telemetry unit. Pediatric unit nurses also need PALS; this telemetry role does not.
- Assess, plan, implement and evaluate care for 4–5 telemetry patients per shift
- Interpret cardiac rhythms and respond to changes and alarms
- Administer medications, including cardiac drips, per protocol
- Educate patients and families on cardiac diagnoses, medications and discharge needs
- Work with physicians, pharmacists and case managers on each patient's plan of care
- Active Colorado RN license or multistate compact license (required)
- BLS required; ACLS required within 6 months of hire
- 1+ year of acute care RN experience
Nights, 7:00 PM – 7:30 AM, three 12-hour shifts per week (36 hours), every third weekend and a holiday rotation.
$42.00 – $58.00 per hour based on experience, plus a $5.00/hr night differential. Sign-on bonus available.
